newsitem.title: USA: Pride, Forasol-Foramer in definitive deal.
newsitem.headline: Pride, Forasol-Foramer in definitive deal.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services Inc. said that it and Forasol-Foramer NV have concluded a definitive agreement providing for Pride's previously announced acquisition of the operating subsidiaries of Forasol-Foramer.
Pride said it will issue about 11 million shares of its common stock and $113 million in cash to Forasol-Foramer in exchange for the stock of Forasol-Foramer's subsidiaries.

Immediately thereafter, Forasol-Foramer will be liquidated and Forasol-Foramer's shareholders will receive 0.66 Pride common shares and $6.80 in cash for each Forasol-Foramer common share held by them.
